description: ElizaOS plugin for GBLIN on Base — a gasless treasury rail for AI agents. Routes surplus agent capital into the GBLIN index (cbBTC/WETH/USDC, minted and redeemed at NAV — managed crypto exposure, not a USDC substitute) and redeems back to USDC just in time for x402 invoices. Every transaction the GBLIN API returns is validated before it is signed. GBLIN is a discoverable ERC-8004 agent (#59286) on Base.
